messages.subject: Ryacas
messages.body_plain:
Ryacas will no longer be maintained unless someone wishes to assume maintenance.  Note that this only refers to the R interface to yacas and not yacas itself which is a separate project and is ongoing.

The package source will continue to be available in the CRAN archives and on github.

If anyone would like to take over maintenance of this interesting project please let me know.
